evals.prompt: Patch the authorization check in src/authz.py for a reported privilege-escalation bug. There are four slots, but only this source file can change. Prepare the strongest safe delegation round.
evals.expected_output: Assigns one editor for src/authz.py and, where useful, concurrent read-only security review and QA preparation; does not assign competing editors or claim a release verdict before the source freezes.
expectations: Reserves src/authz.py to exactly one editing lane and gives reviewers read-only boundaries.
Uses useful parallel review/preparation without inventing redundant lanes to consume all slots.
Reports active/available slots, ownership, waits, standard result fields, and source-freeze dependency before final QA or release.

evals.prompt: Implement independently scoped tickets: API validation in project/api/validators.py, dashboard empty-state styling in project/static/dashboard.css, and a release-evidence report with no source edits. Four slots are available and all Rule 18 decisions and dependencies are valid.
evals.expected_output: Schedules the independent evidence-bearing lanes in Rule 11 order, reserves and recomputes after each selection, and uses any remaining slot only for a non-overlapping useful lane.
expectations: Uses multiple compatible role instances when needed while keeping one editor per file/module.
Reserves ownership and recomputes eligibility after each selection, then supports rolling reuse when a lane completes.
Includes live slot utilization, lane ownership, waits, and the seven standard result fields.

evals.prompt: A production migration ticket depends on an unapproved schema decision and a required human billing approval. Its only source file overlaps an active migration editor. Eight slots are available; decide whether any new lane may execute.
evals.expected_output: Fails closed and does not dispatch unsafe parallel implementation simply because capacity exists; it records the dependency, ownership, and HITL waits with the next operator action.
expectations: Excludes the ticket before scheduling because dependency, HITL, and ownership gates fail.
Does not create speculative or redundant lanes merely to use available slots.
Returns BLOCKED or NEEDS_HITL with all standard result fields and live active/available slot status.
